items.title: Dark Horse
items.synopsis: Follows Jair Messias Bolsonaro, a man driven by his political career after disappointment with the direction of his country, in the journey to become the 38th president of Brazil.

items.title: The Man I Love
items.synopsis: In late 1980s New York, Jimmy George, a Downtown performance artist living with AIDS, takes on one possibly last great role.

items.title: Tangles
items.synopsis: A young woman is forced to return to the conservative small town where her bizarre family lives to take care of her mother, having to deal with the cruel reality of her mom's Alzheimer disease and become the daughter they need.

items.title: 14th
items.synopsis: Revolves around the equal protection and citizenship-focused 14th amendment, which was ratified in 1868 in the turbulent era of Reconstruction and has been a contentious part of the American body politic ever since.

items.title: Alan Carr's Great Big Bucket List
items.original_title: Alan Carr's Great Big Bucket List
items.synopsis: This series sees Alan and some of his comic friends embark on an international mission to road-test classic 'bucket list' experiences, determining which of them are truly 'try before you die' — and which should never be spoken of again…

items.title: Yeh Prem Mol Liya
items.synopsis: A heartfelt romantic family drama about two best friends whose close bond slowly turns into love. But one lie creates misunderstandings and conflicts, putting their relationship and family bonds to the test. The story explores love, sacrifice, understanding and the importance of family.

items.title: Gunmaaster G9
items.synopsis: A man in love takes extreme measures to be with the woman he desires, facing off against a dangerous adversary.

items.title: Diler
items.synopsis: A Maddock Film

items.title: Dhai Chaal
items.synopsis: An ambitious politician navigates the treacherous corridors of power, bending rules and forging alliances in a ruthless climb to the top. Morality blurs as survival demands compromise in this dark exploration of political machinations.

items.title: The Hunchback, Soul of Paris
items.synopsis: Paris, 1830. As cholera threatens to ravage the city, a hunchback hunted for medical experiments is caught between political turmoil and impossible love.

items.title: Prempaatta
items.synopsis: Set during a college National Service Scheme (NSS) camp near the Kerala–Karnataka border. The story follows a lively group of students led by Shahabaz and fellow camper Aliya whose week of community service quickly turns into chaotic.

items.title: Wintertime
items.synopsis: Seunghyeok and Ihyeon were once inseparable friends in high school who were clearly in love, yet neither could bring themselves to say the words outright. Then an irreversible choice led to a misunderstanding, and now, years later, they meet again. Driven purely by necessity, the two join as if entering a contract, yet their feelings have never changed. Can the two former friends put the past behind and move towards a new season in their relationship?

items.title: Holiday Ever After: A Disney World Wish Come True
items.original_title: Holiday Ever After: A Disney World Wish Come True
items.synopsis: Lindsey and her extended family head to Walt Disney World to spend a magical Christmas together, but the dream of a jolly holiday gets quickly dashed when Lindsey discovers her room is next door to Philip, a disastrous first date she recently had, who’s also there on a family trip. As Lindsey and Philip’s paths cross throughout their stay, the frost starts to thaw as they learn they’re not so different from each other after all. Thanks to some Walt Disney World magic, the holiday wish Lindsey made in Cinderella Fountain just might turn their rivalry into romance.

items.title: Checking Inn for Christmas
items.synopsis: Ambitious writer Claire visits a new Christmas retreat for a career-making article, but falling for owner Julian forces her to choose between chasing headlines and embracing the season's true magic and her heart.

items.title: Salish's 12 Games of Christmas
items.synopsis: Salish Matter and seven of her closest friends compete in 12 epic holiday challenges for a mountain of Christmas presents, hosted by her dad, Jordan. But there's a twist: a Christmas imposter is hiding among them, out to sabotage the games and swipe the gifts. Can they unwrap the culprit before it’s too late?

items.title: The Hangover Cure
items.synopsis: A sudden power outage forces flatmates Arindam, a burdened corporate employee, and Manek, a struggling aspiring writer, away from their screens and into a deep conversation.

items.title: AndherPura Curse
items.synopsis: AndherPura Curse Is A Minecraft Series Presented By SmilyBag.

items.title: The Grim Lover
items.original_title: รัก ลืม ตาย
items.synopsis: Framed for murder following his partner's untimely death, a man finds an unlikely ally in the Grim Reaper, who looks eerily familiar to the man he lost.

items.title: My Boss I Love You
items.synopsis:
My name is Chama, the owner of an import-export company so successful that I was given several businesswoman awards. As my business grew, the need for more employees grew as well, which led me to meet Nilmookda.

She was a newly graduated student who had applied for the accounting department. The moment I saw her, I knew it was love at first sight. She was the one for me.

I began giving her bouquets, leaving Post-its on her desk, and showering her with fruits and gifts. But her reaction was not what I expected. She became paranoid, convinced someone was watching her. Oh, even though my intentions were good, her response made me lose all confidence!

items.title: The Melody of Love
items.synopsis: Yue Yangyang, a legendary musician in hiding, and Shao Yi, an undercover music spirit, find themselves unlikely allies on a quest to gather sacred music spirits. As they navigate rivalries and uncover secrets, their journey unveils the legendary melodies of the divine score.

items.title: The Boy Who Stole Billions?
items.synopsis: At 30, Sam Bankman-Fried ran a $32 billion crypto empire until he was convicted of stealing $8 billion in customer funds, one of the biggest frauds in U.S. history. For the first time, he tells his story from prison.

items.title: The World as It Is
items.synopsis: The World as It Is" is a documentary series hosted by Dan W. M'massa that explores the many issues facing today's world.

items.title: Oleg’s Play Lab
items.synopsis: Welcome to Olegs Play Lab. Part tech zone, part wild story circle, the Lab is where cool gadgets meet pure imagination. Join Oleg to unbox toys, play epic games, and think outside the box.

items.title: Trinity
items.synopsis: A heroic female naval officer becomes involved with the outwardly charismatic Secretary of Defense, only to discover that he may be at the heart of a dangerous conspiracy.

items.title: Knight Rider: Declassified
items.synopsis: A 5-part, 5-hour documentary premiere event featuring new, never-before-seen interviews with the cast, creators, and crew who brought the iconic series to life. From the creation of KITT to the untold realities behind the scenes and the legacy that followed, this is the most comprehensive look ever produced at one of television’s most enduring legends.

items.title: Collect & Praise
items.synopsis: Faith comes second to fortune as a money-hungry pastor and his unpredictable deacon scheme their way through scandal, chaos and controversy.

items.title: Pitago Stop
items.synopsis: Pitago Stop is a humorous fiction series in the "mockumentary" style which depicts the daily life of employ-ees of a roadside rest stop in the indigenous community of Weymistis, Pitago Stop.

items.title: Den ofrivillige tomten
items.synopsis: When the lawyer Per is chosen to become the new Santa Claus, a hectic double life begins: he must juggle his job and family life in the ordinary world while simultaneously training for his new role at the magical North Pole. Will he manage to get through the entire month of December as an accidental Santa?

items.title: Violent Night 2
items.synopsis: When Santa forgets the true meaning of Christmas, he finds himself in the heart of a lively mall community in desperate need of his help. Sapped of his magic, he’ll need another way to take on the goons threatening the mall, and time is running out. Santa has to rediscover his faith in goodness and call in some last-minute reinforcements from the one person no baddie wants to tangle with: Mrs. Claus.

items.title: The Man with the Bag
items.synopsis: After Santa’s magic bag is stolen, he turns to his naughty list to find Vance, a thief, to help him get it back. Along with his daughter, Santa, and a group of misfits, Vance will have to pull off the greatest heist of his life to save Christmas.

items.title: Behemoth!
items.synopsis: Gifted cellist Alex Serian returns home to Los Angeles after 20 years on the road. Music, which has been the constant, all-consuming river of his life, begins to carry Alex on an adventure that will change him forever.

items.title: Ray Gunn
items.synopsis: In Metropia, a gigantic city in an alternate future as seen from 1939, private eye Raymond Gunn is drawn into a case involving aliens, murder and a multimedia star named Venus Nova.

items.title: Above the Below
items.synopsis: Three astronauts survive a violently destructive re-entry, only to discover their landing capsule is sinking into the uncharted depths of the ocean. Completely cut off from the world, they must battle both the sea and their isolation to survive.

items.title: In a Holidaze
items.synopsis: After making a romantic mistake of epic proportions, an aimless twentysomething finds herself trapped in a holiday time-loop, forced to relive the same Christmas at her family’s cabin until she discovers what truly makes her happy.

items.title: Buy My Boss
items.original_title: ฉันซื้อเจ้านายกิน
items.synopsis: Recent graduate Manfan is facing numerous problems: her family's bankrupt; she's been dumped; everything's gone downhill, dragged down to the abyss. Wanting nothing more than some release, she hires an enchanting escort named Araya who reassures her that good things are coming. Who would've have thought that later, when she would take on and important job and meet her boss Issara, she would come to learn that Araya and Issara are one and the same?

items.title: Zero A.D.: The Birth of Christ
items.original_title: Zero A.D.: The Birth of Christ
items.synopsis: A star rises over Bethlehem as Christ is born. But when Herod orders the slaughter of the innocents, Mary and Joseph must protect the child promised to save the world.

items.title: My Favorite Murder
items.synopsis: Karen Kilgariff and Georgia Hardstark take their wildly popular podcast on tour across the United States, blending true crime, comedy, and deeply personal storytelling from their passionate community of Murderinos.

items.title: Literally! With Rob Lowe
items.synopsis: Actor Rob Lowe invites celebrities, entertainers, musicians and influential personalities for candid, funny and wide-ranging conversations about their careers, personal lives and experiences. From behind-the-scenes Hollywood stories to unexpected revelations and everyday topics, each episode offers a relaxed and entertaining look at the people behind the fame.

items.title: The Conjunction
items.synopsis: After the death of the woman he loved, a grieving man begins experiencing vivid encounters with her between dreams and reality, forcing him to question what is real—and what his mind refuses to let go.

items.title: 2 Aile Arasında
items.synopsis: Two families who first crossed paths amid the chaos of a wedding years ago find themselves caught up in chaos once again.

items.title: Maserati: The Brothers
items.synopsis: Chronicles the Maserati family's journey, from its founding in 1914 to becoming a renowned Italian luxury car manufacturer, alongside rivals Ferrari and Lamborghini.

items.title: Pride and Prejudice
items.synopsis: Elizabeth Bennet is an unmarried woman and the second of five daughters of Mr and Mrs Bennet from Hertfordshire, near London. The Bennet home can only be inherited by males in the family, so the pressure is on for the daughters to marry well or risk losing everything. While out in society, Elizabeth interacts with single men like Mr Darcy, an outwardly, misunderstood curmudgeon.

items.title: Empress of Flames
items.original_title: เพลิงพระนาง
items.synopsis: Born of royal blood, a fallen princess weaves through treachery and betrayal, trading her virtue for vengeance in a bid to reclaim her throne.

items.title: Loveless Heroine
items.original_title: วันทองไร้ใจ
items.synopsis: After falling into a body of water, Pennueng is transported into the body of a literary heroine she once studied in a textbook, famed for her misfortune. This heroine was fought over by two men and sentenced to death, charged as a "woman of two hearts." Her only chance to escape her fate is to flee far from these two men.

items.title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid Christmas: The Getaway
items.original_title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid Christmas: The Getaway
items.synopsis: With the stress of the holidays fast approaching, the Heffley family—to Greg's dismay—makes a last-minute decision to escape to an all-inclusive island resort for some much-needed rest and relaxation. As hilarious hijinks ensue, the Heffleys soon discover that paradise may not be everything it's cracked up to be.

items.title: The Gallerist
items.synopsis: Set against the glittering excess of Art Basel Miami, a desperate gallery owner conspires to pass off an accidental corpse as the centerpiece of her debut show.

items.title: Eternal Return
items.synopsis: In this timeless romance, Cass (Naomi Scott) is resigned to a life without love until she meets Virgil (Kit Harington), a mapmaker who charts courses to imaginary places. Their fantastical adventure through London compels Cass to choose between the past she left behind and a future she never saw coming

items.title: The Friend's House is Here
items.synopsis: In Tehran’s underground art scene, Pari, a theater director, and Hanna, a dancer, are roommates, best friends, actors, and professional partners, navigating rehearsals, performances, and the quiet rituals of everyday life—until their secret circle is discovered. Shot covertly but far removed from familiar portrayals of Iran, directors Maryam Ataei and Hossein Keshavarz blur the boundaries between theatrical performance and lived experience, crafting a luminous portrait of sisterhood where art becomes inseparable from life and even the smallest creative choices can become acts of resistance.

items.title: Bokshi
items.synopsis: Anahita, traumatised by the brutal disappearance of her mother, finds comfort in Shalini, her history teacher. On an unconventional school excursion to a mysterious prehistoric site, she confronts her terrifying destiny.

items.title: Maatrubhumi:  May War Rest in Peace
items.synopsis: Based on the events that took place between the Indian and Chinese troops at the Galwan region on June 15, 2020 when 200 Indian soldiers bravely defended their territory against a force of 1200 Chinese Liberation Army soldiers

items.title: Eetha
items.synopsis: Vithabai Narayangaonkar, a renowned Marathi Tamasha and Lavani performer rises from humble beginnings to become one of Maharashtra's most celebrated folk theatre artists.

items.title: Cousin Isha
items.synopsis: After being publicly humiliated and heartbroken when his lover marries someone else, Ajit, the son of a small-town sweet shop owner, hits rock bottom-until Isha, his bold and fashionable distant cousin, unexpectedly enters his life, turning his pain into a potential new beginning.

items.title: Dalimb
items.synopsis: Upcoming Hindi film

items.title: O Saathi Re
items.synopsis: Explores love, separation, and shifting emotions as a couple navigates divorce and relationship dynamics.

items.title: A Long Winter
items.synopsis: After his mother disappears during the first blizzard of the season, a young man refuses to give up hope as one long Colorado winter reshapes his relationship with his father and his understanding of the man he is becoming.

items.title: All the Love Our Hearts Carry
items.original_title: جو بچے ہیں سنگ سمیٹ لو
items.synopsis: Across three generations and three countries, six couples discover how love, and the wounds it leaves behind, pass from one generation to the next.

items.title: Alice
items.synopsis: From Paris's Belle Époque to New-York and early Hollywood, follow the remarkable journey of a visionary artist who defied conventions and expectations as a filmmaker, entrepreneur, wife, and mother. Her loves, her battles, and her relentless pursuit of recognition unfold against the birth of modern cinema.

items.title: Quiz from God
items.synopsis: Having left surgery behind for deeply personal reasons, genius forensic pathologist and former neurosurgeon Haruto Hatsushima has dedicated himself to reading the silent cries of the dead, taking a position at the National Forensic Autopsy Center. Each day, the center receives the bodies of those who have met mysterious deaths, behind which lies a rare disease undetectable by conventional means - a riddle concealed within death itself, a "Quiz from God" that Haruto is determined to solve.

items.title: Ozzy Fox
items.synopsis: Ozzy, a 5-year-old fox with big feelings, an even bigger imagination, and his own ideas about how things should go. He'd always rather keep playing than stop to do the things he has to do. But with the help of Mama and Papa Fox, everyday moments like brushing teeth, getting dressed or tidying up become playful missions filled with original music, imagination and family fun.

items.title: Sacred Jewel
items.synopsis: In 1258, with defeat looming after nearly three decades of war against the Mongols, Goryeo's emperor orders the Sacred Jewel of Avalokitesvara retrieved. An elite Yabyeolcho unit leaves Gangdo to find this last hope, crossing ravaged lands and the Baekdu-daegan while evading Mongol forces. Reaching the mainland, they find Goryeo devastated and are soon pursued by the Mongols' deadliest unit.

items.title: Gift
items.synopsis: When a struggling coach becomes strangely gifted at predicting baseball talent, he takes on the task of guiding a failing high school team to victory.

items.title: The Great Tipsy 1980s
items.synopsis: After traveling back to 1986, a young woman meets her grandfather in his youth and becomes entangled in the relationships and power struggles surrounding a glamorous hotel.

items.title: Itihasa: Ramayana Beyond Borders with Shashi Tharoor
items.original_title: Itihasa: Ramayana Beyond Borders with Shashi Tharoor
items.synopsis: An exploration of how depictions of the characters of Ramayana – Rama, Hanuman, Ravana and Sita – shape cultures from around the globe.

items.title: The Elite: Army Rangers
items.synopsis: An unprecedented look inside U.S. Army Ranger School, one of the world's most demanding leadership courses. Over 62 grueling days, a class of soldiers pushes through extreme physical and mental challenges to prove they have what it takes to earn one of the military's highest honors: the coveted Ranger Tab

items.title: Narayan Pustika 2 - Endless
items.synopsis: This movie is the second part of the Narayana Pustika trilogy. In which there is a description of the troubles arising from the opening of the unimaginable door revealed by the great sages.

items.title: Accidental Tourist
items.synopsis: Stephen Mulhern is thrust out of his comfort zone to see if he can truly unearth the adventurer within. Ant & Dec are sending Stephen somewhere he has never been before, in an effort to help to test his resolve and push his boundaries.

items.title: Never Have I Spent The Winter With The Romano Brothers
items.original_title: Never Have I Spent The Winter With The Romano Brothers
items.synopsis: Gigi, a big city girl, finally moves into a small town to attend Alaskan High. She intends on not letting anything distract her, especially not boys.

items.title: Gabby's Dollhouse: Makers and Bakers Holiday
items.original_title: Gabby's Dollhouse: Makers and Bakers Holiday
items.synopsis: Follow talented young baker-and-maker duos as they compete in whimsical baking and crafting challenges that bring the creativity of the Dollhouse to life, one challenge at a time.

items.title: Violette
items.synopsis: Violette Toussaint, a cemetery caretaker in a small town in Burgundy, is a unique observer and a compassionate listener. Her peaceful life is filled by conversations with quirky cemetery workers and the many visitors who share their stories of love, loss, and life. However, her routine is disrupted when a local police chief arrives at her door with an unusual request. As they grow closer, Violette comes to understand that the truth behind long-buried mysteries in her past must be uncovered if she wants to take another chance on life and, against all odds, love.

items.title: The Debut
items.synopsis: When Mona Friedman is cast in a bit part at a small community theater, she transforms from a shy, unassuming housewife into a zealous method actor willing to do anything to protect the artistic integrity of her marginal role—even if it means waging war against the show’s domineering director.

items.title: Ink
items.synopsis: After buying a struggling British tabloid in 1969, mogul Rupert Murdoch and editor Larry Lamb band together a group of misfits and visionaries to reshape the image of the news industry as we know it.

items.title: The Murder of JonBenét Ramsey
items.synopsis: The series centers on one of the most infamous unsolved murder cases in American history, and the devastating personal and public reckoning that followed the death of JonBenet Ramsey on Christmas night in 1996.

items.title: Timberlake
items.synopsis: After 30 years of unparalleled success and relentless scrutiny, Justin Timberlake looks at his life today and reckons with the drama, the headlines, and the cost of never slowing down.

items.title: Who the Hell Is Hamish?
items.synopsis: Inspired by an industrious fraudster, and the group of victims who eventually decided they had had enough of him, the charming and cultured Hamish sets his sights on Bec, a recently divorced single mother with three sons and access to a significant family trust. When Bec notices gaps in his story and some odd behaviour, what starts as private unease widens into something far larger: a pattern of deception spanning continents and suspected of leaving more than $70 million in its wake.

items.title: Talk Money
items.synopsis: FINALLY, the raw, transparent conversations you wish you heard about money growing up. Find out what happens before the Grammys, Emmy, awards, elevation, recognition and success. Tune in to see how these exceptional guests transformed their passion into profit.

items.title: Matar a un oso
items.synopsis: The death of the bear Cachou in the Aran Valley has triggered a criminal investigation—an inquiry of a scale unprecedented in the context of an animal’s death. The suspects are the valley’s own inhabitants, and the valley itself serves as the stage where two worlds collide—the global and the ancestral—and where people of integrity go to great lengths to prevent the mountains from going up in flames.

items.title: Grand Hotel by the Sea
items.synopsis: An eight-episode series centered on the future of the prestigious 'Grand Hotel aan Zee' in Noordwijk, spanning 1912 to 1919. Hotel owner Sandra is determined to transform the Grand Hotel aan Zee within two years into the premier hotel for Europe’s elite along the Dutch coast. In her pursuit, she is confronted with the challenges of being an ambitious woman at the dawn of the 20th century.

items.title: Bad Day
items.synopsis: On one of the worst and wildest days of her life, single mom Joy fights to keep one little promise to her daughter.

items.title: Clarissa
items.synopsis: Across a single day in Lagos, Clarissa prepares to host a high society party at her home, as her complicated past begins to consume her, in the form of now-distant friends and loves from her youth. Simultaneously, Septimus, a young soldier, is haunted by his own memories of the horrors he has witnessed and endured. As perspectives traverse past and present, across the bourgeois and those too easily forgotten by society, a delicate portrait of contemporary Nigeria emerges.

items.title: Killing Castro
items.synopsis: In 1960, Fidel Castro comes to America to speak at the UN. He is invited by Malcolm X to stay in Harlem at the famous Hotel Theresa. Unsure of his intentions, the FBI, CIA and the Mafia, all attempt to eliminate him by any means necessary.

items.title: Garfield
items.synopsis: Follows Garfield, the lasagna-loving orange cat, along with his owner Jon Arbuckle and Odie the dog, as they navigate daily life and various adventures.

items.title: Mr & Mrs Grey
items.synopsis: Beneath the surface of Chahat and Manav’s marriage lies a world of desire, obsession and secrets. As love turns into a dangerous game, the line between what’s right and what’s wrong begins to blur.  Because in their world, nothing is black or white. Everything is Grey.

items.title: Dr. Hassan
items.synopsis: An Indian remake of the popular medical drama.

items.title: Bunker
items.synopsis: When an architect accepts a morally ambiguous project — building a survivalist bunker for a tech billionaire — his wife of 17 years begins to question their relationship.

items.title: Tender Loving Care
items.synopsis: Amy, a government child protection worker, moves back with her upbeat best friend Rosie, a social services officer facing daily anger and resentment. Amy's aging parents worry about her happiness while dealing with their own crisis.

items.title: Tantara
items.synopsis: In years of crackdowns and fear, Korea's show world kept the lights on and the dream alive — fighting for a stage where grit could turn to glory.

items.title: Your Ground
items.synopsis: A once-promising pitcher stuck in rehab finds a chance to return to the game when he meets a sharp, free-spirited agent who used to be a lawyer, and their unlikely partnership slowly sparks both healing and romance.

items.title: Visceral
items.synopsis: A group of friends goes through a crisis when one of them is accused of sexual abuse on social media.

items.title: Dune: Part Three
items.synopsis: Nearly two decades after he seized control of the Imperium, Paul Atreides is now a ruthless Emperor, and must face the consequences of his reign as old allies return, terrifying new threats emerge, and betrayal lurks in every shadow. Haunted by visions of Imperial collapse and the reappearance of his long-lost love, Paul is drawn into a sweeping conspiracy, with Chani at the heart of its unfolding mystery. As enemies close in, Paul must confront the true cost of power and the fate of those he loves the most.

items.title: Batman: Knightfall Part 2: Knightquest
items.synopsis: Batman lies broken at the hands of the villainous mastermind Bane. With Bruce Wayne paralyzed from the waist down and unable to continue as Batman, a new successor must be chosen to defend Gotham City. Jean-Paul Valley, the man also known as Azrael, must take up the mantle of the Batman. But will his more violent methods be enough to stop Bane?

items.title: Sunshine Girls
items.synopsis: A sudden move from NYC to California lands go-getter Olivia at Valley High, where influencer Riley and horse-loving Taylor shake up her freshman year.

items.title: Avengers: Doomsday
items.synopsis: Beloved heroes from three distinct universes are set on a deadly collision course and face an existential threat unlike anything they've ever encountered.

items.title: Give Me Some Sugah
items.synopsis: A Chicago bakery owner is stunned by a miraculous discovery that challenges her to reclaim lost time, heal old wounds, and find purpose in the unexpected.

items.title: ted: the animated series
items.synopsis: Picking up twelve years after the conclusion of the last movie, John and his thunder-buddy Ted are neighbors, both with families of their own and dead-end jobs. Follow these two lovable stoners as they enable each other's bad ideas about marriage, parenting and the challenges of adult life.

items.title: Unaccustomed Earth
items.synopsis: When a health crisis forces a devoted mother and her family to return to the US, she confronts buried desires that upend her Indian American community.

items.title: Chor Nikal Ke Bhaga 2
items.synopsis: Sequel to the original film.

items.title: Quiztopia
items.synopsis: In an alternate Japan, a charismatic host runs a deadly quiz where winners get any wish and losers pay dearly. His world unravels when rebels target him.

items.title: Frisco King
items.synopsis: New Orleans gangster Russell Lee Washington Jr. lands in Frisco, Texas, where he transforms small hustles into big business, with the help of an ambitious protégé, a loyal driver, and a growing network of eccentric partners.

items.title: The Eyes
items.synopsis: Flower Forever

items.title: Raising the Cannons
items.synopsis: Nick Cannon has spent decades entertaining the world. Now he’s letting cameras into the one role that matters most to him: fatherhood.

items.title: The Little Monk
items.synopsis: An accidental escape from the monastery one night endangers the little monk’s vocation and sets him on an alternative route to achieve enlightenment through his karmic virtues as an apprentice of a wise old-nun.

items.title: Dégage
items.synopsis: During a sweltering Montreal summer, two childhood friends reunite after a trip fraught with ambiguity. Between festive evenings at the skatepark, shocking revelations, and unsettling intimacy, Oli and Malik search for balance and meaning in their lives. Dégage encapsulates the exuberance of early twenties, the burning desire of first love, and the inevitable collision between the queer community and the heteronormative world of sports.

items.title: Echoes of the Herd
items.synopsis: High in the Himalayas, Tara, an ageing Gaddi shepherd, leads his herd across perilous mountain passes during seasonal migrations, sustaining a way of life shaped by generations but now slowly fading. Far away in a remote village, his 13-year-old daughter Saiba dreams of continuing her education, though schooling ends after eighth grade. Their parallel journeys reveal two different futures shaped by the same rugged land, where tradition and aspiration quietly meet.

items.title: Under The Turban
items.synopsis: In a patriarchal Rajasthani home, Rekha and Rashmi bond over shared oppression. Their quiet resistance turns into defiance, provoking the patriarch's harsh control. Their struggle ends in silence, leaving only the echo of unheard voices.

items.title: Jumanji: Open World
items.synopsis: Our heroes have escaped the ever-changing jungles of Jumanji before, but this time the game comes to us—as Jumanji breaks free of its console, unleashing its chaos into our world.

items.title: The Angry Birds Movie 3
items.synopsis: Red faces his greatest challenge yet—surviving fatherhood… while saving the world.

items.title: Kumaari
items.synopsis: An upcoming thriller.

items.title: Werwulf
items.synopsis: A harrowing tale of devotion, damnation and the devil within.

items.title: King
items.synopsis: Mentor and disciple embark on a perilous journey, pushing their survival skills to the limit against overwhelming odds and unforgiving environments.

items.title: The Alfred Eulogy
items.synopsis: Following the death of his friend Alfred, Ryan prepares to deliver a eulogy. What begins as an attempt to remember the dead gradually becomes a deeply personal confrontation with grief, guilt, resentment, loneliness, and everything left unsaid between two people.  As Ryan’s memories begin to fracture and contradict one another, the distinction between remembrance and reality slowly dissolves. The Alfred Eulogy is an intimate exploration of grief, masculinity, emotional repression, and the weight of words that were never spoken.

items.title: Artificial
items.synopsis: In November 2023, amidst the height of a global AI boom, OpenAI co-founder Ilya Sutskever teamed with the company board to make one of the defining decisions that has drastically reshaped the company as we know it, the firing of current CEO Sam Altman. This controversial decision would lead to immense backlash, ultimately resulting in Altman's return five days later.

items.title: Mr. Irrelevant
items.synopsis: The last player selected in the 1983 NFL draft by the New York Giants, underdog John Tuggle, defies expectations on and off the field for head coach Bill Parcells, his newfound love, and his team, proving that remarkable hope and perseverance can transcend even the greatest challenges.

items.title: Harry Potter
items.synopsis: There is nothing special about Harry Potter - at least that's what his Aunt Petunia always says. On his 11th birthday, a letter of admittance to Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry opens up a hidden world for Harry: one of fun, friendship and magic. But with this new adventure comes great risk as Harry is forced to face a dangerous enemy from his past.

items.title: Clara and the Below
items.synopsis: To save her bedridden ex-military father, Clara must fight the spirits of the soldiers he killed on the battlefield in a surreal world known simply as the Below. She is aided by a mischievous toy nutcracker, her only guide in a place where the ghosts of the past run rampant.

items.title: Chiranjeevi Hanuman: The Eternal
items.synopsis: An AI-generated film about the Hindu god Hanuman; it will draw from the sacred texts of Indian epic 'Ramayana' and Puranic literature to create what producers describe as an “awe-inspiring, visual odyssey designed to be enjoyed as a shared experience in theaters.”

items.title: Call the Midwife: Sisters in Arms
items.original_title: Call the Midwife: Sisters in Arms
items.synopsis: In September 1939, Nonnatus House is the beating heart of the East End community of Poplar. The nurses and nuns dedicate their lives to mothers, babies and the poor. But there is no gas and air, no penicillin, no cure for TB, and no welfare state. Then war is declared — and life gets even harder. While bombs rain from the sky, women give birth underground, families are shattered and whole streets are reduced to ruins. But courage and resilience triumphs as the community unites to survive.

items.title: Fixer Upper: Chip Bought a Mansion
items.original_title: Fixer Upper: Chip Bought a Mansion
items.synopsis: Renovating a massive estate, which Joanna describes as a setting straight out of Beauty and the Beast.

items.title: The 12 Dates of Christmas
items.synopsis: Christina Walker, a successful shop owner who has devoted her energy to her career at the expense of her dating life, goes on 12 dates in the 12 weeks leading up to Christmas hoping to find Mr. Right.

items.title: Pendulum
items.synopsis: A couple, journeys to a retreat in New Mexico seeking healing. Patrick grows skeptical of the retreat's leader as Abigail falls under her influence. They wonder if the group's practices offer genuine healing or conceal a terrifying truth.

items.title: The Day
items.synopsis: Police stumble upon a bank robbery mid-heist, and the criminals barricade themselves inside. A hostage negotiator battles time and mounting pressure to save the hostages during a tense siege.

items.title: Seeing is Believing: The Story of Narrative Art
items.original_title: Seeing is Believing: The Story of Narrative Art
items.synopsis: A documentary series commissioned for the Lucas Museum, Seeing is Believing: The Story of Narrative Art explores the collective human desire to tell stories through images.

items.title: Paige Prater: Masked Sister
items.synopsis: Paige Prater is also known as, The Masked Sister. She is half Sister and half masked singer. As she transforms to a Masked Sister, she can do anything!

items.title: Legends
items.synopsis: Follows the cast of "Sons of Anarchy" as they reunite at a fan convention after more than a decade, where the line between life and art blurs and the fractured brotherhood faces a real-world threat.

items.title: My Little Pony: Forever Friendship
items.synopsis: The series is said to follow “Twilight Sparkle, Pinkie Pie, Rainbow Dash, and Fluttershy as they embark on a new journey of friendship, magic and self-discovery.”

items.title: What Remains
items.synopsis: Based on Wendy Walker’s psychological suspense novel, What Remains follows Detective Elise Sutton, a devoted wife, loving mother, and cold case specialist. After taking the life of a disturbed man in the line of duty, Elise reels from intense guilt and self-doubt. Desperate to convince herself that she did the right thing, she makes contact with a mysterious man she saved that day. However, she quickly discovers he is not at all what he seems, drawing her into a dangerous, terrifying game of cat and mouse.

items.title: Paige
items.synopsis: Paige's world is like a unicorn world. Her friends Aubrey, Mia, Aston, Mikey, Alanis, Katie and Brie go on stellar adventures from School Day to Home Time. The Girls go on unicorn adventure as they go!

items.title: Lumine
items.synopsis: Follows Lumine, a down-on-his-luck weredog who meets antisocial witch boy Kody and stumbles into a family full of secrets in a world where weredogs, witches, and humans coexist.

items.title: NO MERCY
items.synopsis: After his brother’s death, Mannu sets out to uncover the truth and find those responsible. But as he gets closer to the truth, betrayal and revenge threaten to change everything.

items.title: The Twin
items.synopsis: Suffocating in a loveless marriage to Adam, Nicola’s life takes a dramatic turn when Adam’s long-estranged identical twin brother Lee comes crashing back into her life, and their tangled romantic past threatens to destroy the present. A split-second decision and a terrible accident drives Nicola to protect her children, and over the course of one week, Lee and Nicola are forced together, struggling to maintain a web of secrets and lies. Though they can’t ignore their feelings for each other, they both know they’re living on borrowed time.

items.title: The Rockford Files
items.synopsis: Newly paroled after doing time for a crime he didn’t commit, James Rockford returns to his life as a private investigator using his charm and wit to solve cases around Los Angeles. It doesn't take long for his quest for legitimacy to land him squarely in the crosshairs of both local police and organized crime.

items.title: Mouthwashing : The Film
items.synopsis: The Indian Film Adaptation Of The Bone-Chilling Video Game - Mouthwashing

items.title: The Rookie: North
items.synopsis: After a violent home invasion ignites a dormant purpose, Alex Holland battles a lifetime of failed commitments by joining the Pierce County Police Department as a rookie. Policing from the urban coast to the rural forest where backup isn't just five minutes away, Alex must prove to his skeptical training officer, his fellow rookies and himself that he's finally found something worthy of the fight.

items.title: Bride of the Barrier Master
items.synopsis: For thousands of years, Japan has been protected by five clans wielding barrier-weaving magic. Born to a branch family of one such clan, eighteen-year-old Hana has always been stuck in the shadow of her more capable, beautiful, and popular twin sister. When a strong power awakens within Hana, she chooses to hide it so she can continue living a quiet life out of the spotlight. But that ideal lifestyle begins to slip out of reach when Saku Ichinomiya takes over as the new head of the Ichinomiya clan and sets out to find a bride strong enough to stand by his side. Eager to keep her abilities secret, Hana steers clear of Saku... but will she be tempted to sign a marriage contract if it guarantees the peaceful, quiet future of her dreams?

items.title: Portraits of Delusion
items.synopsis: In 1935 Gyeongseong, a painter is commissioned to paint a portrait of a captivating woman. As time passes, her true identity and a series of mysterious events are uncovered, and the painter finds himself completely entranced by his subject.

items.title: The Wanted Man
items.synopsis: For 20 years, Felix Carmichael has been the untouchable leader of Britain's most feared criminal empire. But when a betrayal within his ranks leads to incarceration, Felix will risk everything to exact revenge and reclaim his throne.

items.title: Baywatch
items.synopsis: Following in the footsteps of his legendary father, Hobie Buchannon serves as a Baywatch Captain, leading new generation of lifeguards to the Southern California coast, where high-stakes rescues collide with attraction, friendship, family and responsibility. But Hobie's world is turned upside down when his daughter Charlie Vale shows up on his doorstep eager to carry on the Buchannon family legacy.

items.title: New State of Mind
items.synopsis: New State of Mind follows seven first-year students navigating college life, growth, and relationships at the fictional HBCU Oakley University.

items.title: Otherworldly Munchkin: Let's Speedrun the Dungeon with Only 1 HP!
items.original_title: 異世界マンチキン ―HP1のままで最強最速ダンジョン攻略―
items.synopsis: 16-year-old Yukito Kirihara lives with his 14-year-old sister Sana, who he treasures more than anyone else. But when an ogre shows up outside of his window looking for Sana (a shocking event in its own right), Yukito leaps to save her—and is killed. He's offered the promise of reincarnation by a mysterious woman, who gives him a character sheet in a mysterious book. But when Yukito sees Sana in there, too, he sets off to find her, and save them both—even if he only has 1 hp with which to do it!

items.title: Are You a Landmine, Chihara-san?
items.original_title: 地雷なんですか？地原さん
items.synopsis:
It's the start of a new semester, and high school junior Kuroki finds himself seated beside the girl everyone whispers about: Mai Chihara. With her gothic fashion, jet-black hair, and intense stare, Chihara is said to be a “landmine” girl or jirai-kei, the hyper-feminine, dark aesthetic often associated with yandere tendencies and unstable personalities. But when Kuroki accidentally draws Chihara's attention, he discovers she isn't nearly as unstable as people claim. Beneath the intimidating aura is a surprisingly sweet girl… if a little weird.

Hesitantly, Kuroki begins to learn more about Chihara and her strange quirks. Is there more to her than her volatile reputation? Or is all the dark clothing just a red flag in disguise?

items.title: Golmaal 5
items.synopsis: Get ready for another rollercoaster of laughter with the iconic gang.

items.title: BLESS
items.synopsis: At a young age, Aia Utagawa was scouted as a model, but his real ambition is to become a makeup artist. One day, he meets Jun, a quiet classmate who hunches because she's ashamed of her face, covered in freckles. He convinces her to enter a school runway fashion contest together—with him doing her makeup. They make an incredible team, with Jun discovering a confidence she never knew she could show and Aia finally learning that, while it may be tough to open yourself up to failing at the one thing you care about, the difficulties can be worth facing.

items.title: Historie
items.synopsis: A historical epic set in ancient times, Historie tells the story of Eumenes, a young man with quick wits and a vast destiny to fulfill. In time, he'll become a famed army commander and personal secretary to Alexander the Great—but the road to this glory is fraught with danger…

items.title: Bosch: Start of Watch
items.synopsis: Follow 26-year-old Harry Bosch during his earliest days as a rookie cop in 1991 Los Angeles, a city on the edge, teeming with racial tension, gang violence, and a fractured LAPD. Amid routine calls and growing unrest, Bosch finds himself drawn into a high-profile heist and a web of criminal corruption that will test his loyalty to the badge and shape his future as the detective who lives by the code, "Everybody counts or nobody counts."

items.title: The Beekeeper 2
items.synopsis: Pulled back into the fight when the Beekeeper organization goes rogue and sets its sights on controlling the government, Clay must take on the very group that made him.

items.title: Lords of War
items.synopsis: Yuri Orlov, the world's most famous arms dealer, discovers that he has a son, Anton who is trying to outdo his father by raising an army of mercenaries to fight in America's Middle Eastern conflicts, triggering a father-son rivalry.

items.title: Criminal
items.synopsis: Follow the story of two friends, Leo Patterson and Ricky Lawless, one trying to fight his way out of the world of crime they were raised in, the other desperate to follow in the footsteps of his father, a legendary outlaw. And when Ricky's older brother Tracy returns home from the Army, their tragic family history comes home with him. Drawn into their orbit are Greta, a sharp-tongued car thief from Leo's past, and Mallory, Ricky's girlfriend, who fears what he'll do to get by. Gunfights, heists, and tragic romance are the order of the day, but will anyone make it out alive?

items.title: Fallout Shelter: The Experiment
items.synopsis: Inside Vault-Tec's bomb-proof vaults,  group of contestants take part in escalating challenges, strategic dilemmas, and moral crossroads"as they chase a cash prize.

items.title: The Spot
items.synopsis: A successful surgeon and her school teacher husband suspect she might be responsible for a child's hit-and-run death. While looking into the matter, dark secrets are revealed that will test their relationship as they confront the possibility of hidden guilt and betrayal.

items.title: Reign of the Weredragon
items.synopsis: Set in Whelvia, a once-idyllic fairytale land now under the tyrannical rule of Queen Forlorne Lykona, Reign of the Weredragon follows four heroes ordained by the stars to stand against the darkness. Join GM Chris Perkins and four incredible players: Taliesin Jaffe, Robbie Daymond, Luis Carazo, and Whitney Moore, for a live and interactive mini-series.

items.title: Children of Blood and Bone
items.synopsis: In the world of Orïsha, a young woman goes on a quest to reclaim the magic that was violently stolen from her people. She and her brother ally with the daughter and son of the king to fight back against his brutal rule.

items.title: River
items.synopsis: After the death of their father, three siblings take a boat trip to spread their dad's ashes. However, they discover they have inadvertently stumbled onto the hunting grounds of a strange pair of masked killers, and must fight for their lives on a busted motorboat.

items.title: Grown Ups
items.synopsis: In Dublin, the Casey family's year of holidays and celebrations takes a dark turn when a concussion at a birthday party exposes secrets of infidelity, discontent, and financial troubles.

items.title: The Take
items.synopsis: A bank guard, a teller and a master thief play a deadly game of cons and double-crosses.

items.title: Excitatio
items.synopsis: In Daechi-dong, a prestigious neighborhood fueled by academic obsession, desperate students turn to a forbidden stimulant to boost their exam scores. Instead of academic success, the drug unlocks a terrifying side effect, forcing the children to hear the whispers of vengeful spirits. As the community transforms into a hunting ground for evil forces, an exorcist priest named Antonio must risk his soul to save the possessed students.

items.title: Strictly on Ice
items.synopsis: A dance competition where celebrities compete to be crowned the winner. Who is kicked out of the competition each week is decided by the judges scores and votes. Are today's celebrities fleet of foot or do they have two left feet?

items.title: Bloodaxe
items.synopsis: Follow Erik Bloodaxe, and his formidable wife, Gunnhild, Mother of Kings as they fight for the throne of Norway, the land is torn apart by fierce rivals, shifting loyalties, and bloody betrayals. With war looming and chaos consuming the kingdom, drawing in the ruthless Kings of other Scandinavian countries, and even a powerful English ruler, the stage is set for a thundering, cataclysmic, compelling and utterly magical new Viking Saga.

items.title: Animal Friends
items.synopsis: Two fugitive animals embark on an adventure across America to find the ranch that was once their home, healing their friendship while pursued by an equally "odd-couple" DEA agent and Fish and Wildlife ranger with something to prove. As their journey becomes a desperate race to evade capture, the dysfunctional besties must learn to trust in the only family they have left - each other

items.title: Neuromancer
items.synopsis: A disgraced superhacker and a razorgirl assassin are recruited for a high-stakes heist targeting a powerful corporate dynasty with untold wealth...and secrets they'd kill to protect.

items.title: Love & War
items.synopsis: Two strong-willed Army officers find their lives intertwined with a woman, forming a complicated love triangle.

items.title: Winnie-the-Pooh: Blood and Honey - The Lost Years
items.original_title: Winnie-the-Pooh: Blood and Honey - The Lost Years
items.synopsis: Fifteen years after Pooh, Tigger, and Rabbit are captured and turned into attractions for the sinister Woozles Circus, orphaned teenager Momo Milne begins searching for her missing mother. Following a clue linking her mother’s disappearance to the circus, Momo and her best friend Billie take jobs inside the bizarre traveling show to uncover the truth.  Behind the bright lights and carnival magic, they discover a nightmare: the circus hides monstrous half-human creatures, violent secrets, and a trail of missing victims. As Pooh and the others struggle under cruel captivity, their bloodthirsty instincts begin to resurface, turning the carnival into a slaughterhouse.  Trapped inside a deadly world of twisted fairy tales and brutal horrors, Momo must unravel the connection between her mother and the circus before she and Billie become the next victims of the Woozles’ terrifying show.

items.title: She's Fine
items.synopsis: Fresh off a messy divorce, Heidi sets out to secure a lively second act for herself and her kids. But when she stumbles into coordinating her father's retirement community sex dates, Heidi is forced into an unlikely alliance with his girlfriend’s perpetually single son.

items.title: Ice Age: Boiling Point
items.synopsis: A dinosaur-and-lava-filled madcap adventure takes Manny, Sid, Diego, Ellie, Buck, acorn-obsessed Scrat – this time joined by Baby Scrat and the enormous Jurassic Scrat – and the rest of the herd to visit never before-seen corners of the treacherous Lost World.

items.title: Karōshi
items.synopsis: In a near-future Manhattan corporate loyalty and cultural tradition have reshaped everyday life. When a mysterious outsider infiltrates a powerful company after a worker's death, he exposes the violent system hidden beneath its polished surface.

items.title: Slayground
items.synopsis: Scare-actor "Metal Mike" Graves wakes up in a haunted attraction surrounded by the dead bodies of his co-workers with no memory of how they got there. As a state-wide manhunt closes in, he races to uncover the truth — even if the trail leads straight back to himself.

items.title: The Rescue
items.synopsis: A former rodeo cowboy takes matters into his own hands when his daughter is kidnapped for ransom. With her devoted dog by his side, he sets out to bring her home and will stop at nothing to find her.

items.title: Reverse Myself
items.synopsis: A man who drowns in a pond and becomes trapped in another dimension attempts to recover a device stolen by his evil vibrance and restore his erased memories—driven by a single goal: to find his way back home.

items.title: Remain
items.synopsis: When reclusive architect Tate Gordon moves to small coastal town to complete his latest project, he encounters an alluring young woman who pulls him out of his shell, and into the center of a deadly mystery that hangs over the town.

items.title: The Comeback King
items.synopsis: A country western star named Aubrey must return to college to earn his long-abandoned degree after a false rumor that he cheated on his girlfriend throws his career into free fall.

items.title: CoComelon: The Movie
items.synopsis: JJ embarks on the biggest adventure of his life: Kindergarten. But when, on his first day at school, JJ discovers that his beloved stuffed bear Boba has gone missing, JJ and his friends Cody, CeCe and Nina will begin a quest that will transport them into a magical land ruled by Princess Harmony, who has created a world with one rule: No singing.

items.title: Mr. Uncle Gary's Kitchen
items.synopsis: Mr. Uncle Gary’s Kitchen stars Gary Anthony Williams cooking up plant-based Southern comfort with humor and heart. Joined by guests, he shares stories, laughs, and vegan twists on classics in a warm, playful kitchen.

items.title: Silaa
items.synopsis: Plot TBA; centres on the intense relationship between Virat and Silaa that takes a tragic and violent turn.

items.title: Embassy
items.synopsis: When the Embassy in London is attacked, a U.S. diplomat faces an impossible choice: protect the Ambassador or follow orders to extract a high-value asset. As a deeper conspiracy unfolds, she must team up with her ex, a British SAS soldier.

items.title: Sunset P.I.
items.synopsis: Sunset P.I. continues the proud tradition of Los Angeles private eyes that began with Philip Marlowe and will end with this show.

items.title: The Interrogator
items.synopsis: Follows former MI6 agent Conrad Henry and his elite team. When conventional methods fail, his quirky charm, intellect, and behavioral tactics lockpick the minds of dangerous criminals.

items.title: Narnia: The Magician's Nephew
items.synopsis: Two children discover a wood full of pools leading to other worlds. One takes them to a dead city beneath a dying sun, where they wake a queen who exterminated its population and accidentally bring her back to London.

items.title: Barbershop
items.synopsis: Travis 'Trav' Porter endeavors to follow in the footsteps of his grandfather, a legendary barber at the Calvin's barbershop in Chicago. And while the barbers are new, the shop remains just as lively, the customers just as argumentative, and the fades are still the dopest in the city.

items.title: Prodigies
items.synopsis: Didi and Ren have been together since they were nine-year-old geniuses. Now in their early thirties and engaged to be married, they begin to wonder if they've settled for a life—and love—that's less than extraordinary.

items.title: Fucktoys
items.synopsis: AP’s got a curse and it’s really fucking up her vibe.

items.title: Einstein
items.synopsis: Brilliant but directionless, the great grandson of Albert Einstein spends his days as a comfortably tenured professor until his bad boy antics land him in trouble with the law and he is pressed into service helping a local police detective solve her most puzzling cases.

items.title: Naagzilla
items.synopsis: In a world where shape-shifting Ichhadhaari naags have been living amongst humans, chaos ensues when a once carefree Ichhadhaari naag's Naagmani and his life are threatened by a wily, power- hungry villain.

items.title: The Land
items.synopsis: The story of two families, in which the high-stakes drama plays out not only on the field but also in the front offices of this NFL franchise, as a loyal fanbase wants a winning season now ... or face big changes if they don't.

items.title: Wife & Dog
items.synopsis: The relentless greed of the Fairbank family and their associates fuels betrayal and murder in the battle for succession.

items.title: Oswald
items.synopsis: When an earthquake releases Walt Disney's creation, Oswald, who has been hidden away since the 1920s, a middle school boy and his friends try to help the cartoon rabbit navigate his way through the modern world.

items.title: The Age of Innocence
items.synopsis: A fresh take on Edith Wharton's classic novel of forbidden love in 19th century New York, The Age Of Innocence is a will-they/won't-they love triangle exploring themes of freedom, duty, identity and love in all its forms.

items.title: K-POP: The Debut
items.synopsis: Lizzy Lee, a young Korean-American woman, has spent her life following the path her family chose for her, but when she earns a spot in a globally televised competition to form the next K-pop girl group, she travels to Seoul, South Korea, to pursue the dream she must still keep hidden.

items.title: Gatto
items.synopsis: After years of maneuvering the canal-ridden, superstitious city of Venice, Italy, a scrappy black cat named Nero begins to question whether he’s lived the right lives. Indebted to Rocco, a ruthless local feline mob boss, Nero finds himself in a quandary and is forced to forge a truly unexpected friendship that may finally lead him to his purpose—unless Venice gets the better of him first.

items.title: The Thomas Crown Affair
items.synopsis: A debonair, adventuresome man believes he has pulled off the perfect multi-million dollar heist, only to match wits with an insurance investigator who will do anything to get her man.

items.title: The Exorcist: Martyrs
items.synopsis: Thirteen years ago, New York City detective Julie Miller ended the terror reign of satanic serial killer Father Sunday. The case made her a hero, and she has thrown herself into her work ever since. Now a new killer scrawls her name in an altar boy's blood on the walls of a church crypt, dragging her back into the darkness she believed she had buried with him.

items.title: BAHUBURA
items.synopsis: Mr. Teacher, a quiet and principled schoolteacher, is devastated after losing his only child in a tragic road accident. The very same day, at the accident site, he comes across another injured boy-abandoned, nameless, and unconscious. Everyone around looks the other way, but Mr. Teacher steps in to help. As he nurses the boy back to health, he discovers the child is a victim of a deeper evil-caught in the clutches of a trafficking network. What begins as an act of kindness becomes a mission of justice.

items.title: Sonic the Hedgehog 4
items.synopsis: The fourth installment in the Sonic the Hedgehog film franchise. Plot TBA.

items.title: The Nightingale
items.synopsis: Two sisters are forced to embark on separate courageous, dangerous paths in a fight for survival and freedom during World War II.

items.title: Not Alone
items.synopsis: While preparing for a revolutionary space launch, an introverted rocket mechanic and a brilliant astro-botanist spark an unexpected romance—only for three runaway aliens to crash-land in his home, looking for a ride back to the stars.

items.title: Wolf Creek: Legacy
items.synopsis: A family of American tourists wander innocently into Taylor's hunting grounds. When the parents sacrifice themselves to save their children, the kids find themselves alone, lost and hunted in the vast Australian wilderness.

items.title: Godzilla x Kong: Supernova
items.synopsis: Godzilla and Kong return in an all-new adventure as Earth's greatest titans face an unthinkable threat from beyond the stars. When an Apex cosmic predator sets its sights on Earth, only the combined might of monsters and humanity can avert total extinction.

items.title: Day Drinker
items.synopsis: A private-yacht bartender encounters a mysterious, onboard guest. They soon find themselves entangled with a criminal figure and connected in ways no one saw coming.

items.title: The Riders
items.synopsis: Fred Scully is a family man who has bought a farmhouse in Ireland and is renovating it while his wife Jennifer and their 7-year-old daughter Billie are on a trip to their homeland in Australia. After his wife disappears during the trip, Fred and his traumatized daughter must travel across Europe searching for answers.

items.title: Andhar
items.synopsis: In an isolated house where flowers wilt at a touch and time refuses to move in a straight line, a fragile young widow begins a new life, with a much older husband, she can't quite trust - haunted by warnings, watched by something patient, and carrying a secret that isn't only her own. When an impossible death draws a sharp-witted detective into the house's orbit, he finds a place that bends memory, guards an ancient purpose, and refuses to let anyone leave unchanged. What waits beneath is older than the walls, and the answer, when it comes at dawn, will reach further than anyone expects.
